interactions.name: pi-pi stacking (parallel-displaced)
interactions.explanation: Two flat aromatic rings stack face-to-face but slightly offset - about 20 deg off the ring normal, like playing cards slid a little apart. In this game the ring planes sit 3.38 A apart and the ring centers 3.60 A apart. Real crystals of these molecules usually pack herringbone (edge-to-face) instead - see serpentrum/data/DATA_SOURCES.md - so this idealized face-to-face geometry is a game approximation. The rule of thumb (parallel-displaced stacking, roughly 20 deg, centroid-centroid up to 3.8 A) comes from Janiak 2000, measured on crystalline metal complexes.
